preto-natural: Natural black, a level 1 black with a soft neutral tone, deep and dense from roots to ends with no visible brown, red or blue cast in normal light. Fully even single-process color, darkest at the roots and underneath, with a gentle cool-neutral sheen where light hits the surface. Rich, healthy glossy shine that still shows individual strands and natural light reflections, a realistic professional permanent dye result.
castanho-escuro: Dark brown, a natural level 3 brunette with a neutral tone, neither warm nor cool: deep coffee-bean brown that reads almost black in shadow and clearly brown in the light. Even, uniform color from roots to ends, the ends a touch softer, with soft neutral-brown reflections on the surface. No red, copper or ashy cast. Healthy glossy shine and subtle natural variation between strands, a realistic salon-dyed result.
castanho-chocolate: Chocolate brown, a level 4-5 brunette with a warm, rich cocoa tone like a solid bar of chocolate: velvety brown with soft warm red-brown reflections and no orange or copper. Even, saturated color from roots to ends, slightly deeper at the roots and underneath, the surface glowing a touch lighter where light hits. Luxurious glossy shine and natural strand-by-strand variation, a realistic professional permanent color.
castanho-medio: Medium brown, a natural level 4 brunette with a neutral to very slightly warm tone: a classic, balanced mid-depth brown with no red, gold or ash dominating. Even single-process color from roots to ends with full opaque coverage, every white or gray strand completely colored, including the roots, part line and temples, deeper in the shadows and underneath and softly lighter on the surface where light falls. Subtle multi-tonal variation between strands and a healthy natural shine, a realistic salon-dyed brunette that looks like natural hair.
castanho-claro: Light brown, a natural level 5 brunette with a soft neutral tone: a clear, light-reflecting brown between medium brown and dark blonde, never golden-yellow, red or gray. Even color from roots to ends, with slightly deeper tones underneath and gentle lighter brown reflections on the surface and ends. Fine natural variation between strands and a soft healthy shine, a realistic professional permanent color result.
preto-azulado: Blue-black, a level 1 jet black with a cool blue reflect: inky, deep black that throws a visible midnight-blue, raven-wing sheen on the highlights where light hits, while the shadows stay pure black. Even and saturated from roots to ends, never looking navy or blue-dyed in the shadows. High-gloss, mirror-like shine with natural strand definition, a realistic professional blue-black permanent dye result.
chocolate-amargo: Dark chocolate brown, a level 3 brunette with a warm, intense cocoa tone like bittersweet chocolate: deep, almost-black brown in the shadows that reveals rich warm chocolate and faint red-brown reflections in the light. Even, saturated color from roots to ends, with no copper or orange. Velvety depth, high glossy shine and subtle natural variation between strands, a realistic professional permanent dye result.
castanho-iluminado: Luminous light brown, a level 5-6 single-process brunette with a soft warm golden-beige reflect that makes all the hair glow: radiant tone-on-tone brown, slightly deeper at the roots and subtly brighter and more golden through the mid-lengths and ends, with no visible highlights, streaks or bleached sections. Even, seamless color with natural strand variation and a high, glassy shine that bounces light, a realistic salon gloss finish.
castanho-caramelo: Caramel brown, a level 6 warm brunette with a golden-toffee reflect: a rich brown infused with buttery caramel and soft amber warmth, like melted caramel sauce. Slightly deeper brown at the roots, warming to brighter caramel through the mid-lengths and ends, seamlessly blended and evenly saturated. Warm but never orange or brassy. Multi-tonal caramel and toffee strands with a glossy shine, a realistic professional salon result.
castanho-mel: Honey brown, a level 5-6 brunette with a warm golden-amber reflect: translucent brown that glows like dark honey held up to the light, with amber and golden glints running through it. Slightly deeper at the roots, luminous and lighter through the mid-lengths and ends, evenly blended with no stripes. Golden but never yellow or orange. Soft multi-tonal variation between strands and a juicy glossy shine, a realistic salon-dyed result.
marrom-glace: Marron glacé chestnut, a level 5 warm chestnut brown with a golden-brown reflect and only a whisper of mahogany, like a glazed candied chestnut: brown clearly dominates, with sweet toasted-gold and faint red-brown glints, never red, auburn or copper. Even, saturated color from roots to ends, deeper in the shadows and glowing warmer where light hits. Glossy, candy-glazed shine and natural strand-by-strand variation, a realistic professional permanent dye result.
cafe-expresso: Espresso brown, a level 2 brunette, the darkest brown before black, with a cool-neutral coffee tone like a fresh espresso shot: almost black at a glance but revealing deep coffee-brown in the light, with no red, copper or blue. Even, dense color from roots to ends, with softer brown glints on the surface. Ultra-glossy, polished shine and natural strand definition, a realistic professional permanent dye result.
mocha-mousse: Mocha mousse brown, a level 5 soft brunette with a muted warm-neutral cocoa tone: a creamy coffee-and-cocoa brown blended with milk chocolate and a delicate beige-gold whisper, low in saturation and never red or brassy. Slightly deeper at the roots, gently softer and lighter through the mid-lengths and ends, seamlessly blended. Velvety, satin-gloss finish with subtle multi-tonal variation between strands, a realistic modern salon color.
castanho-acinzentado: Ash brown, a level 5 brunette with a cool ash tone: a smoky, matte-leaning brown with soft gray-taupe undertones and absolutely no red, copper or golden warmth. Even color from roots to ends, slightly deeper and cooler in the shadows, with cool silvery-brown reflections on the surface. Subtle multi-tonal strand variation and a soft satin shine, a realistic professional toned brunette result.
castanho-dourado: Golden brown, a level 5 brunette with a clear warm golden reflect: a sunny, rich brown with gold glints woven through it, like toasted bread crust. Even color from roots to ends, deeper golden-brown in the shadows and brighter warm-gold reflections where light falls. Warm but never orange, red or yellow. Glossy healthy shine and natural strand-by-strand variation, a realistic professional permanent dye result.
preto-acastanhado: Soft brown-black, a level 2 natural black with a warm brown undertone: reads as black at first glance, yet the light reveals a gentle deep-brown softness instead of harsh jet black. Even from roots to ends, with the darkest depth underneath and soft dark-brown glints on the surface and ends. No blue or red reflect. Natural, healthy glossy shine and visible strand detail, a realistic professional soft-black dye result.
chocolate-ao-leite: Milk chocolate brown, a level 6 warm brunette with a soft, creamy cocoa reflect: a lighter, sweeter chocolate brown with gentle warm red-brown and caramel undertones, never orange or copper. Slightly deeper at the roots, evenly creamy through the mid-lengths and ends, with lighter milk-chocolate glints on the surface. Smooth glossy shine and subtle natural variation between strands, a realistic professional permanent color.
preto-intenso: Jet black, an intense level 1 black at maximum saturation: pure, opaque, ink-like black with zero brown, red or blue showing anywhere, deep and uniform from roots to ends. The surface has a glassy, lacquered, mirror-like shine with bright neutral-white light reflections, while every shadow stays deep black. Dense, fully even pigment that still shows realistic individual strands, a professional high-gloss black dye result.
avela: Hazelnut brown, a level 6 brunette with a soft nutty golden-beige reflect: a warm-neutral, toasted-hazelnut brown that is gentle and natural, neither red nor ashy. Slightly deeper at the roots, with lighter golden-beige hazelnut glints through the mid-lengths, ends and surface, seamlessly blended. Low-contrast multi-tonal dimension, soft glossy shine and natural strand variation, a realistic professional salon color.
castanho-bege: Beige brown, a level 5-6 light brunette with a soft neutral beige reflect: a creamy, sandy café-au-lait brown perfectly balanced between warm and cool, with no red, copper, strong gold or gray. Slightly deeper at the roots, softly lighter and more beige through the mid-lengths and ends, seamlessly blended. Muted, low-contrast and elegant, with subtle strand-by-strand variation and a soft satin shine, a realistic professional toned brunette.
castanho-frio: Cool brown, a level 4 brunette with a neutral-cool tone: a medium-dark brown neutralized of all red and gold, with a soft cool pearl-ash undertone that reads clean and modern rather than gray. Even color from roots to ends, slightly deeper and cooler underneath, with cool neutral-brown reflections on the surface. Smooth satin-gloss shine and subtle natural variation between strands, a realistic professional toned brunette.
castanho-cogumelo: Mushroom brown, a level 5 brunette with an earthy, muted taupe tone: a cool-neutral brown blended with soft ash-gray, beige and a faint smoky mauve, like the underside of a mushroom. Deeper taupe-brown at the roots and underneath, lighter ash-beige brown through the mid-lengths and surface, low-contrast and seamless. No red, copper or gold. Velvety satin shine and realistic strand-by-strand variation.
castanho-rose: Rose brown, a level 5 brunette with a dusty rose-mauve reflect: a soft chocolate-brown base that reveals a delicate pinkish rose-gold and mauve glow where light hits, while the shadows stay brown. Slightly deeper at the roots, with the rosy tone more visible through the mid-lengths and ends, seamlessly blended. Subtle and wearable, never bright pink or red. Satin-gloss shine and natural strand variation, a realistic salon color.
castanho-ameixa: Plum brown, a level 3-4 brunette with a deep violet-red reflect: a dark brown base infused with ripe plum and aubergine tones that read brown in the shadows and glow rich purple-plum in the light. Evenly saturated from roots to ends, slightly deeper underneath, never bright purple or fuchsia. Glossy, jewel-toned shine and natural variation between strands, a realistic professional permanent dye result.
preto-violeta: Violet black, a level 1-2 black with a cool violet reflect: deep black that shows a subtle purple, eggplant-like sheen on the highlights where light hits, while the shadows stay true black. Even and saturated from roots to ends, never looking purple-dyed. High-gloss shine with natural strand definition and soft variation between strands, a realistic professional violet-black permanent dye result.
